class.name: NNBTRepeatUntil
class.brief_description: Ticks its child until the child returns the [member expected_tick_result], or until [member max_repeat_times] ticks are exhausted.
class.description:
The RepeatUntil node ticks its first enabled child until [member expected_tick_result] is returned by its child, or until [member max_repeat_times] ticks are exhausted. If [member max_repeat_times] is negative (such as [code]-1[/code]), only [member expected_tick_result] ends the loop. If [member max_repeat_times] is [code]0[/code], the node immediately returns [code]FAILURE[/code] without ticking its child. Reaching [member expected_tick_result] completes the node with [code]SUCCESS[/code] and exhausting [member max_repeat_times] without a match completes it with [code]FAILURE[/code].
A terminal result completes the run. The next tick starts a fresh run with a new repeat budget, so a RepeatUntil that finishes starts over instead of holding its result. Wrap the RepeatUntil in [NNBTRunOnce] to hold the completed result instead.

method.name: get_times_repeated
method.description: Returns the number of times the child node has been ticked in the current run.

members.member: The status the child must return to end the loop ([constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE], [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING], or [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS]). When returned, this node completes with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS].

The maximum number of times the child node can be ticked in a run. Exhausting the budget without getting [member expected_tick_result] completes the run with [code]FAILURE[/code]. Set to [code]0[/code] to fail immediately without ticking the child, or to a negative value (such as [code]-1[/code]) to repeat without a budget.
